items.title: Is Steel Dynamics (STLD) A Bargain After Its New Q3 2026 Earnings Guidance?
items.summary: Steel Dynamics (STLD) put fresh numbers on the table on September 17, issuing third quarter 2026 earnings guidance of US$5.34 to US$5.38 per diluted share, giving investors a clearer profit yardstick. The fresh guidance lands after an active stretch for Steel Dynamics, where the share price has slipped 4.11% over the past day even though the year-to-date share price return is 33.62% and the 1-year total shareholder return is 70.94%.
